description: One Hyperliquid wallet, by `view`. `summary`: live equity, open positions, both cohort labels, the risk metrics of the window (`win_rate` is a FRACTION from 0 to 1; `max_drawdown_pct` and `pnl_pct` are percents, `pnl_pct` is null under $1 of equity), cumulative realized PnL since inception and lifetime deposits and withdrawals, all money in USD; `equity.account_value` is the wallet's whole value in the venue's unified and portfolio-margin modes (native perp account + builder accounts + USDC outside them, free spot tokens left out; those modes also read null on the drawdown fields), else the native perp account; `equity.perp_account_value` is always the native perp account and `equity.account_mode` is `default`, `unifiedAccount`, `portfolioMargin` or `disabled`; `open_positions.perp_bias` = (long - short) / `equity.perp_account_value` and `equity_exposure` = (long + short) / it, native perp account only: positions on the main dex over the native perp account value; builder-DEX positions are not included. Unbounded ratios, null with no main-dex position or no positive equity. `trades_summary`: closed round-trip trade statistics overall and per symbol, medians as well as means. An address we hold nothing for (`summary`) or that never traded (`trades_summary`) is an error, never a block of zeros. Find addresses with hl_leaderboard, hl_perp_top_traders or hl_position_match. Same data as GET /v1/hyperliquid/wallets/{address} and /wallets/{address}/trades/summary.

address.description: Hyperliquid wallet address: 0x followed by 40 hex characters, any case. Required.

opened_within.description: Bounds the open-positions block ONLY (equity, lifetime and metrics are wallet-level totals with nothing per-position to filter): `24h`, `7d`, `30d` or `all`. Used by view: summary.

view.description: What to read. `summary`: equity, open positions, cohort labels, risk metrics and lifetime flow. `trades_summary`: closed-trade statistics overall and per symbol. Default `summary`.

window.description: Window of the risk metrics and trade statistics, by trade time: `1d`, `7d`, `30d` or `all`.

title: Hyperliquid Wallet
